question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Triumphant
solution: The correct answer is '**Victorious**'. ***__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Triumphant**' is '**Victorious**'. • **Triumphant**: feeling or showing great happiness because you have won or succeeded at something. (विजय या सफलता की प्राप्ति पर अत्‍यंत प्रसन्‍न; विजयोल्‍लसित) • *Example: Toni gave Jessi a **triumphant** look.* • **Victorious**: having won a victory; triumphant. (विजयी, फ़तहमंद) • *Example: the **victorious** team...* **Correct Answer:__** Victorious.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Fortunate**: lucky. (भाग्‍यशाली) • **Pompous**: showing that you think you are more important than other people, for example by using long words that sound impressive. (स्‍वयं को दूसरों से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण समझते हुए और भाषा व्‍यवहार में इसका प्रदर्शन करते हुए; तड़क-भड़क वाला, आडंबरपूर्ण) • **Affluent**: having a lot of money. (धनवान, समृद्घ) 190:Tbc8, The correct answer is **'She told me that she had seen that old man long before.'**
